games.name: [The Lakehouse] Entry Point: Freelancer's Cut
games.desc:
The Freelancer's Cut is open for early access. Currently, five of the eight mission remakes are available in game, along with several community created levels.

This is a niche game with a lot of complexity and a steep learning curve. I highly recommend checking out the free demo first to see if this game is for you.
https://www.roblox.com/games/740581795/Entry-Point-Freelancers-Cut-Demo

Rejoin the criminal organization of Halcyon in this pack of remastered Entry Point missions. With new tactics, reworked skills, and expanded mission concepts, try your hand at running elaborate covert infiltrations - sneak, bluff, hack, or force your way through any way you can. There are only two rules: Get the job done and don't get caught doing it.

games.name: Egg Toss [2 Players]
games.desc:
👍 LIKE the game and join the group to get Free Fossil Egg!
🥚 Don't let your team's egg fall short or overshoot the catch.

How to play: 
- Pair up with your friend and choose your team.
- Toss and catch the egg to keep your team in the game.
- Distance between the pair gets farther with each successful catch.

⭐ 2 Game Modes to have fun
Classic - Start with one egg only. The last team with an unbroken egg wins!
Survival -  Get a new egg every round and outlast deadly lava. The last team standing wins!

🔥 Earn wins to unlock egg skins and climb the leaderboard!

games.name: [FREE UGC] Carry Me! [2 Player Obby]
games.desc:
Updates bi-weekly!

Free Ice Lantern from joining our group! 

Embark on a long and painful journey with your partner as you jump, dive, throw, and climb to the top. This game is progressively difficult and can be rage - inducing. Remember to take frequent breaks and stay hydrated.

1. Hit E on your buddy to pair up with them!
2. Press E to pickup your buddy!
3. Throw your buddy by pressing E again!

👍 Thumbs up for future updates!

[ If public servers are too difficult, you can create a free private one! ]
Credit for some icons go to Digby Garrett

games.name: Word Search!
games.desc:
Play word search puzzles in Roblox!

Start a word search and find hundreds of different words on a grid! Beat puzzles to get exp and level up, and unlock more fun gamemodes to play! Work together with your friends to find words! Complete MILLIONS of different word search puzzles to level up and get on the leaderboard!

🧠 Relax and work with your mind as you complete puzzles. Word searches are a great way to ease yourself and get smarter! Relieve your stress as you enjoy the puzzle.

Have fun!

games.name: Crash Cars with Nitro
games.desc:
🏎️ Crash Cars with Nitro is a high-octane racing and crashing simulator where you drift, boost, and smash through stunt-filled tracks and chaotic worlds! Soar off ramps, dodge obstacles, and blast past rivals with nitro-fueled speed. Wreck opponents, unleash mayhem, and most important of all, have fun! 🌟

🎮 Keybinds:
Ctrl – Sprint

games.name: [QUESTS 🌌] The Hybrid Cafe ☕
games.desc:
Seems like your new cafe job didn't turn out how you expected...

☕ Mix and serve countless combinations of delicious drinks and snacks to hungry customers! Earn tips to buy upgrades and decorate your cafe! Enjoy the sound of waves and the cool breeze as you work on a tropical island.

⚠️ However, running a cafe isn't that easy! Despite aggressive people, broken machines and earthquakes, you're expected to stop at nothing to serve our loyal customers... You have been warned...

Type /return in the chat in-game to quickly return to the lobby.

Built by @real_haemster. Programmed by @Bili_Billie.

games.name: The Silent Ascent
games.desc:
Using only your grappling hook to traverse a realm of towering grey pillars, mysterious biomes, dangerous creatures, and strange inhabitants. 

- Every climb is different, each Ascent is randomly generated.
- Play solo, or bring your friends!
- Create a party to work together!
- Collect Essence to purchase hats and faces, and style your perfect climber.

Controls
Click / Right Trigger - Grapple
E / D-Pad Up - Reel In
Q / D-Pad Down - Reel Out
Jump (At Wall) - Climb
H / D-Pad Left - Call Out

The Silent Ascent launched on April 13th, 2026.
The game is currently in Beta.
This game is currently being worked on by one developer, I'm trying my best to keep updates consistent!
v2.0.0
